properties.rows: array of plain objects via JS property
properties.headerActions: {value,label?,disabled?:boolean|(column)=>boolean}[] via JS property; appends custom header items

attributes.caption: string
attributes.row-action: deprecated legacy label; provides single action in right-click menu

accessibility.action: right-click context menu, row keyboard target with Shift+F10/ContextMenu, menuitems, disabled handling and focus restoration
accessibility.headerMenu: right-click/Shift+F10/ContextMenu on column header; sortable headers keep native buttons; non-sortable headers focusable; sorting + column visibility menus
